subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should Docker-hosted Gateway installs automatically remap sandbox bind sources from Gateway-container paths to host Docker paths, or should OpenClaw require operators to configure identical host/container workspace paths?
rationale: This choice changes the sandbox bind-source trust model and Docker install contract, so automation should not choose between implicit remapping and stricter operator setup on its own.

options.title: Approve explicit host-path remapping
options.body: Add a narrow remap path based on the Gateway container mount table, then validate remapped sources against the existing blocked-path and allowed-root policy with real DooD proof.

options.title: Require identical host/container paths
options.body: Keep runtime strict, but add doctor/docs diagnostics that detect mismatched Docker Gateway volume maps and tell operators how to fix them without dangerous bind overrides.

options.title: Limit the fix to materialized skills
options.body: Handle only the state/skill mount subset tracked by the related open issue, leaving workspaceAccess users to configure matching paths manually.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit host-path remapping
recommendation.body: Add a narrow remap path based on the Gateway container mount table, then validate remapped sources against the existing blocked-path and allowed-root policy with real DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history signal for the sandbox workspace mount and shared sandbox plumbing that the decision would change.
